_howto: Copy this file, fill 'records' with REAL prices from an official source, and set MARKET_PRICE_FILE=<path> in .env. Every record needs a price date and the source it was copied from. Leave is_sample false (or omit it). Do not put guessed or made-up prices here.

record_format.unit: PKR per 40 kg   (or: PKR per kg, PKR per 100 kg)
record_format.price_date: YYYY-MM-DD   (or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ if the time is known)
record_format.source_title: <name of the page / report the price came from>
record_format.provider: amis   (only if copied from AMIS Punjab; otherwise omit)
